summary: The change adds an optional first-party GitHub App OAuth client. The client takes its credentials from Secret Manager, is wired through the config schema and ControlPlane, and gets per-stack Pulumi IAM grants and env vars. Both round-1 findings are resolved. F1: the weak exemption is gone, and a temp test drives readControlPlaneConfig through the development and Cloud Run paths for the unset, partial, trimmed and failed-read cases. F2: a Pulumi-mock temp test checks the both-or-neither guard, the grants and the env entries. The durable tests now also check that the authorize URL carries client_id, uses PKCE and has no scope, and that the client is absent when GitHub is unconfigured. Every test run passes, the coverage gate passes, and no findings remain.
